2607.25890.title: Distributing Security Controls Through Harness Engineering
2607.25890.paper_summary: AI coding agents are being adopted at historic speed, yet security and risk concerns remain the primary barrier to scaling agentic AI across organizations. Existing security controls for coding agents are not systematically distributed to engineering teams, and vendor-native solutions introduce ecosystem dependencies that may not suit every deployment context. This paper investigates whether off-the-shelf security controls can be implemented on commercial AI coding agents and scaled to a distributed user base via a custom agent harness. A phased testing methodology was applied across four agent configurations --- two commercial agents with and without controls, a baseline harness, and a security-hardened harness --- using a 23-test suite derived from the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications. SHarD (Secure Harness Distribution), a distributable harness built on the Pi agent harness, demonstrated that three categories of security controls --- OS sandboxing, skill scanning, and tool restriction --- can be embedded and distributed via a single install command while retaining equivalent efficacy to direct installation on commercial agents. SHarD achieved an adjusted score of 100\%, matching the best securely configured commercial agent, with no regression across any test category. Notable observations include evidence that model non-determinism produces inconsistent security outcomes and that autonomous agent behavior can cross system boundaries in ways that OS sandboxing directly mitigates. Initial characteristics toward a control harness fitness framework are proposed, and a third research question is identified for future investigation.
2607.25890.paper_summary_zh: AI 編碼代理正在以歷史性的速度被採用，但安全和風險問題仍然是推廣代理 AI 在各組織中的主要障礙。現有的安全控制措施並未系統性地分配給工程團隊，而供應商原生解決方案則引入了生態系統依賴，這可能不適合每個部署環境。本文探討是否可以在商業 AI 編碼代理上實施現成的安全控制，並通過自定義代理工具進行擴展以服務分散的用戶基礎。採用了一種分階段的測試方法，涵蓋四種代理配置——兩種商業代理，分別有和沒有控制、一個基準工具和一個安全強化的工具——使用了一個基於 OWASP 前 10 名代理應用程序的 23 項測試套件。SHarD（安全工具分發），一個基於 Pi 代理工具構建的可分發工具，證明了三類安全控制——操作系統沙箱、技能掃描和工具限制——可以通過單一安裝命令嵌入並分發，同時保持與在商業代理上直接安裝的等效效能。SHarD 的調整得分為 100\%，與最佳安全配置的商業代理相匹配，且在任何測試類別中均未出現回歸。值得注意的觀察包括證據表明模型非確定性會產生不一致的安全結果，以及自主代理行為可以以操作系統沙箱直接緩解的方式跨越系統邊界。提出了控制工具適應性框架的初步特徵，並確定了未來研究的第三個問題。
